questions.def: Use 'to + base verb' after 'want'.
questions.question: I want ___ to the party tonight.

questions.def: 'Enjoy' is followed by the gerund form (-ing).
questions.question: She enjoys ___ books in her free time.

questions.def: Use present perfect for actions started in the past.
questions.question: I ___ here since last year.

questions.def: 'Agree' is followed by 'to + base verb'.
questions.question: They agreed ___ us with the project.

questions.def: 'Stop' + -ing means to cease an action.
questions.question: He stopped ___ coffee because it was bad for him.

questions.def: 'Make' + object + base verb (no 'to').
questions.question: He ___ me laugh every time I see him.

questions.def: 'Need' is followed by 'to + base verb'.
questions.question: We need ___ some milk from the store.

questions.def: 'Remember' + -ing means remembering a past event.
questions.question: I remember ___ him last year.

questions.def: Use present simple for routine actions.
questions.question: She ___ to the gym three times a week.

questions.def: 'Hope' is followed by 'to + base verb'.
questions.question: I hope ___ you soon.

questions.def: 'Keep' is followed by the gerund form (-ing).
questions.question: He keeps ___ the same mistake.

questions.def: Use present perfect for duration of an action.
questions.question: They ___ here for five years.

questions.def: 'Promise' is followed by 'to + base verb'.
questions.question: She promised ___ me a gift.

questions.def: 'Avoid' is followed by the gerund form (-ing).
questions.question: He avoided ___ me at the party.

questions.def: Use present simple for habits.
questions.question: I ___ breakfast before I leave.

questions.def: 'Can't help' is followed by the gerund (-ing).
questions.question: I can't help ___ when I see him.

questions.def: 'Postpone' is followed by the gerund form (-ing).
questions.question: They postponed ___ the meeting.

questions.def: Use past simple for completed actions in the past.
questions.question: I ___ him yesterday at the park.

questions.def: 'Pretend' is followed by 'to + base verb'.
questions.question: She pretended ___ sick.

questions.def: 'Suggest' is followed by the gerund form (-ing).
questions.question: He suggested ___ a movie.

questions.def: Use present simple for regular habits.
questions.question: They ___ football every Sunday.

questions.def: 'Refuse' is followed by 'to + base verb'.
questions.question: He refused ___ me his car.

questions.def: 'Miss' is followed by the gerund form (-ing).
questions.question: I miss ___ my family.

questions.def: Want + to + base form of the verb is the correct pattern.
questions.question: I want ___ to the party tonight.

questions.def: Enjoy is followed by the gerund (verb + -ing).
questions.question: They enjoy ___ football on weekends.

questions.def: Use the past simple after 'ago' to indicate finished time.
questions.question: It ___ to rain an hour ago.

questions.def: 'Stopped to' means stopped in order to do something.
questions.question: She stopped ___ a coffee.

questions.def: Need + to + base form of the verb is the correct pattern.
questions.question: I need ___ some groceries after work.

questions.def: Use present perfect for an action started in the past.
questions.question: I ___ to learn Spanish for years.

questions.def: Decide + to + base form of the verb is the correct pattern.
questions.question: They decided ___ a new car.
